title: Script template
role: Anyone writing a Bolt App as a script, or curious what one can show
saves: Working out the kit, the views, the pictures, the cache and the checks from scratch
summary: Type =script-template: a showcase on free public-domain art (Art Institute of Chicago, no key): number tiles with meters and sparklines, a list with a big picture in the preview pane, a chart, a table, a picture grid and a detail view. Copy it and point it at your own API.
